notes: Fast Track UX overhaul: removed downward cone arrows and vertical peg beacons (the 'rays of light' that got in the way) — pulsing halo rings are now the sole peg/destination cue; clicking a destination hole stages and (if unambiguous or re-clicked) commits a move directly; single-choice moves (including card-7 splits with only one combination) auto-commit without requiring a Confirm press; on desktop the peg button bar is hidden entirely (board clicks are primary input); on phones the bar becomes a full-width docked tab panel and the card deck floats 5px directly above it
